FORMAT LINEAGE: Sebastian Raschka & Maxime Labonne • DeepSeek-R1 GRPO & RLVR
How Reasoning Models Are Built: Cold-Start SFT -> GRPO -> Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) -> Test-Time Compute
Sebastian Raschka & DeepSeek-R1 post-training breakdown: why dropping the PPO critic model and training against deterministic compilers unlocked reasoning.

WHY GRPO REPLACED PPO FOR REASONING MODELS (~50% LESS RL VRAM)
PPO requires training a Value Critic model as large as the Policy model just to estimate baseline variance. GRPO
replaces that entire 70B network with a 5-line z-score across G=8 sampled completions.
ENTERPRISE PLAYBOOK: WHEN TO USE HARNESS VS. SFT VS. GRPO / RLVR
LEVEL 1 • PROMPT + DETERMINISTIC HARNESS (90% OF ENTERPRISE TEAMS)
Start here: wrap a frontier or reasoning model (Gemini 4 Argon / Gemini 3.8 / DeepSeek-R1) in a
loop guard, Contextual RAG, and a sandboxed pre-completion verifier.
LEVEL 2 • COLD-START LoRA SFT / DISTILLATION (LATENCY & COST COMPRESSION)
Use when your Level 1 harness works, and you want to distill verified trajectories from a large
model into a fast 7B-14B model for 10x cheaper serving.
LEVEL 3 • GRPO + RLVR ON DOMAIN VERIFIERS (PROPRIETARY REASONING MOAT)
Use when you have a deterministic domain verifier (SQL query execution, Terraform validate,
formal policy prover, chip layout DRC) and want superhuman domain accuracy.
Rule: If you can write a deterministic verifier (exit_code == 0), you can use it today as a runtime harness gate — and tomorrow as an RLVR training reward.
